18707-gilbert-keith-chesterton.title: Gilbert Keith Chesterton
18707-gilbert-keith-chesterton.creator: Maisie Ward
18707-gilbert-keith-chesterton.description: A book by Maisie Ward. THE MATERIAL FOR this book falls roughly into two parts: spoken and written. Gilbert Chesterton was not an old man when he died and many of his friends and contemporaries have told me incidents and recalled sayings right back to his early boyhood.

arxiv-2011-11416.title: Oscillations and Random Walk of the Soliton Core in a Fuzzy Dark Matter Halo
arxiv-2011-11416.creator: Xinyu Li, Lam Hui, Tomer D. Yavetz
arxiv-2011-11416.description: Abstract A Fuzzy Dark Matter (FDM) halo consists of a soliton core close to the center and an NFW-like density profile in the outer region. Previous investigations found that the soliton core exhibits temporal oscillations and random walk excursions around the halo center.

arxiv-2303-06032.title: Exploring Adversarial Attacks on Neural Networks: An Explainable Approach Thanks: * Wenkai Tan and Justus Renkhoff are co-first authors.
arxiv-2303-06032.creator: Justus Renkhoff, Wenkai Tan, Alvaro Velasquez, William Yichen Wang, Yongxin Liu, Jian Wang, Shuteng Niu, Lejla Begic Fazlic, Guido Dartmann, Houbing Song
arxiv-2303-06032.description: Abstract Deep Learning (DL) is being applied in various domains, especially in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Consequently, it is of great significance to ensure the robustness of these methods and thus counteract uncertain behaviors caused by adversarial attacks.

arxiv-2309-15940.title: Context-Aware Entity Grounding with Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs
arxiv-2309-15940.creator: Haonan Chang, Kowndinya Boyalakuntla, Shiyang Lu, Siwei Cai, Eric Jing, Shreesh Keskar, Shijie Geng, Adeeb Abbas, Lifeng Zhou, Kostas Bekris, Abdeslam Boularias
arxiv-2309-15940.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Haonan Chang, Kowndinya Boyalakuntla, Shiyang Lu, Siwei Cai, Eric Jing, Shreesh Keskar, Shijie Geng, Adeeb Abbas, Lifeng Zhou, Kostas Bekris, Abdeslam Boularias. We present an O pen- V ocabulary 3D S cene G raph (OVSG), a formal framework for grounding a variety of entities, such as object instances, agents, and regions, with free-form text-based queries.

arxiv-2310-16745.title: Design Space Exploration of Sparsity-Aware Application-Specific Spiking Neural Network Accelerators
arxiv-2310-16745.creator: Ilkin Aliyev, Kama Svoboda, Tosiron Adegbija
arxiv-2310-16745.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a promising alternative to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) for deep learning applications, particularly in resource-constrained systems. This is largely due to their inherent sparsity, influenced by factors such as the input dataset, the length of the spike train, and the network topology.

arxiv-2411-10969.title: REDUCTION OF POISSON MANIFOLDS WITH HAMILTONIAN LIE ALGEBROIDS
arxiv-2411-10969.creator: Yuji Hirota, Noriaki Ikeda
arxiv-2411-10969.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuji Hirota, Noriaki Ikeda. A reduction theorem for Poisson manifolds with Hamiltonian Lie algebroids is presented. The notion of compatibility of a momentum section is introduced to the category of Hamiltonian Lie algebroids over Poisson manifolds. It is shown that a compatible momentum section is a Lie algebra homomorphism, and then the quotient space of the zero level set of a compatible momentum section proves to be a Poisson manifold.

arxiv-2502-00086.title: Polynomial Tail Decay for Stationary Measures
arxiv-2502-00086.creator: Samuel Kittle, Constantin Kogler
arxiv-2502-00086.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Samuel Kittle, Constantin Kogler. We show on complete metric spaces a polynomial tail decay for stationary measures of contracting on average generating measures. Introduction Let X be a complete metric space. For a continuous map g:X\to X denote by \rho(g) the Lipschitz constant of g defined as \rho(g)=\min\{\rho>0\,:\,d(gx,gy)\leq\rho\cdot d(x,y)\text{ for all }x,y\in X\}, where we use throughout this paper the notation gx=g(x) for all x\in X . Consider the semi-group L(X)=\{g:X\to X\,:\,\rho(g)<\infty\} of Lipschitz maps.

arxiv-2503-23981.title: Federated Structured Sparse PCA for Anomaly Detection in IoT Networks Thanks: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant 12371306. ( Corresponding author: Xianchao Xiu. )
arxiv-2503-23981.creator: Chenyi Huang, Xianchao Xiu
arxiv-2503-23981.description: Abstract Although federated learning has gained prominence as a privacy-preserving framework tailored for distributed Internet of Things (IoT) environments, current federated principal component analysis (PCA) methods lack integration of sparsity, a critical feature for robust anomaly detection. To address this limitation, we propose a novel federated structured sparse PCA (FedSSP) approach for anomaly detection in IoT networks.

arxiv-2507-03172.title: Topological gravity for arbitrary Dyson index
arxiv-2507-03172.creator: Torsten Weber, Marco Lents, Johannes Dieplinger, Juan Diego Urbina, and Klaus Richter
arxiv-2507-03172.description: Abstract We use the well established duality of topological gravity to a double scaled matrix model with the Airy spectral curve to define what we refer to as topological gravity with arbitrary Dyson index β \upbeta ( β \upbeta topological gravity).

arxiv-2512-06902.title: BabelCoder: Agentic Code Translation with Specification Alignment
arxiv-2512-06902.creator: Fazle Rabbi, Soumit Kanti Saha, Tri Minh Triet Pham, Song Wang, Jinqiu Yang
arxiv-2512-06902.description: Abstract \acmArticleType Review \acmCodeLink https://github.com/profile/repo \acmDataLink htps://zenodo.org/link \acmContributions . 1. Abstract As software systems evolve, developers increasingly work across multiple programming languages and often face the need to migrate code from one language to another. While automatic code translation offers a promising solution, it has long remained a challenging task.

arxiv-2601-19255.title: LLM-Assisted Logic Rule Learning: Scaling Human Expertise for Time Series Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2601-19255.creator: Haoting Zhang, Shekhar Jain
arxiv-2601-19255.description: Abstract Time series anomaly detection is critical for supply chain management to take proactive operations, but faces challenges: classical unsupervised anomaly detection based on exploiting data patterns often yields results misaligned with business requirements and domain knowledge, while manual expert analysis cannot scale to millions of products in the supply chain.

Gut microbiota are composed of...

pmc-10542332.title: ALK fusions in the pan-cancer setting: another tumor-agnostic target?
pmc-10542332.creator: Aditya Shreenivas, Filip Janku, Mohamed A. Gouda, Hui-Zi Chen, Ben George, Shumei Kato, Razelle Kurzrock
pmc-10542332.description: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) alterations (activating mutations, amplifications, and fusions/rearrangements) occur in ~3.3% of cancers. ALK fusions/rearrangements are discerned in >50% of inflammatory myofibroblastic tumors (IMTs) and anaplastic large cell lymphomas (ALCLs), but only in ~0.2% of other cancers outside of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), a rate that may be below the viability threshold of even large-scale treatment trials.

pmc-11460891.title: Association of metformin use with asthma development and adverse outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11460891.creator: Rui Rao, Juan Mei, Hudie Chen, Chuanjing Yang
pmc-11460891.description: Background:Asthma and diabetes are prevalent chronic diseases affecting a significant population globally. Research has suggested that metformin, a commonly used medication for diabetes management, may also have beneficial effects in enhancing asthma outcomes. Considering the comorbidity of asthma and diabetes, a comprehensive analysis was performed to investigate the efficacy of metformin in reducing adverse outcomes of asthma patients with diabetes.

pmc-11543756.title: Vagus nerve stimulation (VNS): recent advances and future directions
pmc-11543756.creator: Christopher W Austelle, Stewart S Cox, Kristin E Wills, Bashar W Badran
pmc-11543756.description: PurposeVagus nerve stimulation (VNS) is emerging as a unique and potent intervention, particularly within neurology and psychiatry. The clinical value of VNS continues to grow, while the development of noninvasive options promises to change a landscape that is already quickly evolving.

pmc-11578835.title: The physiological determinants of symptom burden in cirrhosis with ascites
pmc-11578835.creator: Nikhilesh R Mazumder, Filip Jezek, Sardar Ansari, Elliot B Tapper, Anna S Lok
pmc-11578835.description: Background & AimsParacentesis is commonly used to manage patient discomfort due to ascites. The relationship between ascites pressure, ascites volume, and patient discomfort has not been elucidated.MethodsWe prospectively enrolled adult patients with non‐malignant ascites undergoing outpatient therapeutic paracenteses from 2021 to 2024 at a tertiary care hospital.

pmc-12837009.title: Retrospective analysis of sexually transmitted infections among people living with HIV and pre-exposure prophylaxis users in Spain
pmc-12837009.creator: María del Mar Arcos-Rueda, Luis Ramos-Ruperto, Carmen Busca, Alejandro de Gea Grela, Fernando Fernández-Hinojal, Ana Delgado Hierro, Inmaculada Quiles-Melero, Alfredo Maldonado-Barrueco, Rafael Mican, Luz Martin-Carbonero, Jose Ignacio Bernardino
pmc-12837009.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to compare the frequency and characteristics of sexually transmitted infections (STI) between people with HIV (PWH) and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) users.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted using nucleic acid amplification techniques (NAAT) for Neisseria gonorrhoeae, Chlamydia trachomatis, and Mycoplasma genitalium in rectal, urine, and pharyngeal samples, as well as serological tests for syphilis.

pmc-13057374.title: Effects of combined Mediterranean diet and physical activity intervention on the gut microbiome and disease progression in individuals with Parkinson’s disease: study protocol for a multicenter, randomized controlled pilot study (PRIME study)
pmc-13057374.creator: Alice Fognani, Rossella Rotondo, Maria Luisa Savo Sardaro, Antonio de Iure, Maria Gaglione, Miriam Casali, Lorenza Leonardi, Fabiana Giada Radicati, Laura Vacca, Michele Guescini, Sabrina Donati Zeppa, Lucia Gatta, Fabrizio Stocchi, Barbara Picconi, Maria Francesca De Pandis
pmc-13057374.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsParkinson’s disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder for which no disease-modifying therapy currently exists, making it crucial to investigate alternative strategies that may slow its progression. The PRIME study will investigate the effects of combined dietary and physical activity interventions- performed in rehabilitative settings with health professional supervision and evaluation, versus single interventions on the gut microbiome in PD.

pmc-13074041.title: Plant-Based Yogurt Using Rice Bran and Grain of Green Rice: Increasing the Protein Content of Raw Materials by Enzymatic Protein Extraction
pmc-13074041.creator: Tarathep Siripan, Hua Li, Sirithon Siriamornpun
pmc-13074041.description: This study investigated rice bran and green Khao Dawk Mali 105 (KDML 105) rice grains as alternative protein sources for plant-based yogurt. However, there is a lack of systematic investigation on the application of enzyme-extracted proteins from green KDML 105 rice and rice bran in fermented yogurt systems.

pmc-13608659.title: Localized Utilization of Silica Fume in High-Volume Fly Ash Concrete Through Densification of the Interfacial Transition Zone
pmc-13608659.creator: Ciren Wangdui, Yu Chen, Erlin Wu, Soufian El Mghari, Yongquan Zhang, Xiaodong Wang, Sen Du
pmc-13608659.description: Interfacial transition zone (ITZ) is usually the weakest area in concrete, especially in high-volume fly ash (HVFA) concrete, where most fly ash particles remain unreacted due to their relatively low reactivity. In this case, some supplementary cementitious materials featuring high reactivity, such as silica fume, are usually added directly into HVFA concrete to improve its ITZ.
